description: The current boot, from /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id. Omitted when unreadable.
Whether this host accepts remote reboot (CONNLOG_ALLOW_REMOTE_REBOOT in the root-only agent.conf). Sent by the daemon on every heartbeat; absent from agents that predate the setting.
What became of the last remote reboot request. Sent on every heartbeat until one is accepted, then dropped.
Why, in words, with X-Reboot-State. Printable ASCII, trimmed, at most 200 bytes; anything else is replaced by a space.

The host-side settings in the root-only agent.conf, as on/off values only (never the file). bmc: BMC polling configured; hostname: CONNLOG_EXPOSE_SYSTEM_INFO; postmortem: CONNLOG_SHARE_POSTMORTEM. Sent by the daemon on every heartbeat, keys in this order; absent from older agents. A case marked "agent": false is one this agent never sends and the platform must still read (a newer agent's key, other spacing or case).
Whether this host takes part in the network map (CONNLOG_NETWORK_MAP in the root-only agent.conf). Sent by the daemon on every heartbeat; absent from agents that predate the setting.

How much this host may find out about its network: CONNLOG_DISCOVERY in the root-only agent.conf, the ceiling the console chooses under. An agent.conf with only CONNLOG_NETWORK_MAP=true reads as peers. Sent by the daemon on every heartbeat, beside X-Network-Map; absent from agents that predate it.
Whether this host runs the checks ConnLog assigns (CONNLOG_CHECKS in the root-only agent.conf). Sent by the daemon on every heartbeat; absent from agents that predate checks.

Whether this host is a collector, reading the customer's own equipment through integrations (CONNLOG_COLLECTOR in the root-only agent.conf). Sent by the daemon on every heartbeat; absent from agents that predate integrations.

How the agent was installed, and so how it is updated: systemd (install.sh; it updates itself from signed releases) docker (the image; a new image is the update, and its settings are the container's environment) or freebsd (the OPNsense and pfSense package; a new package is the update). Sent by the daemon on every heartbeat; absent from agents that predate the image, which are all systemd installs.

The host's distribution: os-release's ID, lowercase, or pfsense, opnsense or proxmox-ve, which the agent reads from their own files. On every heartbeat from agent 1.23; absent from older agents. Kept for every host: the map draws its mark from it.
What the distribution derives from (os-release ID_LIKE), nearest first, one to four ids: the mark for a derivative without its own. Sent with X-Os-Id where the host has one.
The distribution's exact version: 22.04.3, 12.7, 14.1-RELEASE-p5, 24.7.5_3. Sent only while the host shares system info (CONNLOG_EXPOSE_SYSTEM_INFO), as its hostname is; kept only then.
